inline_expand_collection_carousel.name: inline_expand_collection_carousel
inline_expand_collection_carousel.description: A horizontal sequence of named collection triggers, each showing a compact preview such as a print stack or scattered thumbnails, that expands inline into a larger browsable arrangement when activated and collapses back to the same position. Fits requests for expandable collection rows, inline gallery openers, categorized photo carousels, and accordion-style image browsers where the causal kernel is localized inline expansion from a compact trigger row.

title_integrated_scroll_gallery.name: title_integrated_scroll_gallery
title_integrated_scroll_gallery.description: A large fixed typographic element anchors the view while images scroll past, behind, or through it at varying speeds, integrating text and imagery into a single composed scroll space. Fits requests for typography-led galleries, title-overlay photo scrolls, text-integrated image showcases, and oversized-heading portfolios where the causal kernel is persistent oversized text anchoring moving images.

opaque_surface_wipe_handoff.name: opaque_surface_wipe_handoff
opaque_surface_wipe_handoff.description: A fully opaque sheet, slab, or band sweeps across the viewport to blanket it, hiding an underlying exchange of screens or content before exiting to uncover the new state. Fits requests for curtain, wipe, sweep, or solid-cover screen transitions where a continuous opaque surface temporarily occludes the view to swap what is behind it.

scroll_paced_content_progression.name: scroll_paced_content_progression
scroll_paced_content_progression.description: Scroll position directly drives the visibility, luminance, layout, or parallax drift of readable passages and visual elements across a sustained vertical journey. Fits requests for scroll-driven storytelling, paced reading sequences, inertial scroll descents, and content that resolves, illuminates, or morphs in step with how far the visitor has scrolled.

assembled_element_reveal.name: assembled_element_reveal
assembled_element_reveal.description: Discrete words, blocks, tiles, or images accumulate, gather, or are swept into place to construct a legible statement or composition from its parts. Fits requests for building up text word-by-word, mosaic block assembly reveals, or elements gathering into a central cluster before settling into their final arrangement.

expansion_flood_detail_transition.name: expansion_flood_detail_transition
expansion_flood_detail_transition.description: A chosen element expands outward or typography floods the viewport to push away the overview, resolving into a focused detail state that can be unwound. Fits requests for topic selection expanding to fill the screen, inline statements flooding with lettering to reveal detail, or items sinking away while text rushes forward into a reading state.

cinematic_threshold_entry.name: cinematic_threshold_entry
cinematic_threshold_entry.description: A dramatic intro or gate sequence using atmospheric motion, impact, timed beats, or enclosing geometry to pass the visitor from a threshold state into the main experience. Fits requests for enter-the-site moments, storm or sound-gated reveals, beat-timed lyric shows, plunging arrivals, and ring-shaped threshold gates.

section_cover_handover.name: section_cover_handover
section_cover_handover.description: An entire section or cover view is replaced by another through a sweeping bar, sliding panel, or full-screen color takeover that hands off the whole viewport. Fits requests for section-to-section transitions, covered handovers with distinct color identities, and label covers sweeping open to reveal poster destinations.

menu_panel_takeover.name: menu_panel_takeover
menu_panel_takeover.description: A menu layer expands, scatters existing elements, or slides opaque blocks over the current view to take over the full frame with navigation options. Fits requests for menus that take over the screen, center-expanding option views, or block-based menu overlays that rewind on dismissal.

scrubbed_state_conversion.name: scrubbed_state_conversion
scrubbed_state_conversion.description: A visitor-controlled scrub or drag drives a visible conversion front, loop, or interpolation between two distinct states of the same image or surface. Fits requests for before-and-after changeovers, tile-flipping conversions, macro-to-whole loops, and any transition where dragging or scrubbing controls the progress of a state change.

pointer_trailing_luminous_strands.name: pointer_trailing_luminous_strands
pointer_trailing_luminous_strands.description: Luminous strands, ribbons, or smoke trails that chase, stretch toward, or bloom from the pointer across a quiet field, with visible lag and elastic return when movement stops. Fits requests for glowing threads following the cursor, light ribbons dragged by the pointer, or velocity-driven smoke trails painting an empty screen.

living_pattern_cell_field.name: living_pattern_cell_field
living_pattern_cell_field.description: A boundless field of autonomously evolving cells or self-organizing chemical-like patterns that continuously mutates, drifts, and can be seeded or inspected through drag and zoom. Fits requests for endless living cell simulations, reaction-diffusion pattern fields, or self-generating organism populations filling the view.

reactive_typographic_word_stage.name: reactive_typographic_word_stage
reactive_typographic_word_stage.description: A single word or letterform built from discrete units—specks, blocks, or glyphs—that breathes, ripples, shatters, or performs stunts in response to pointer movement, dragging, or tapping. Fits requests for particle text that scatters and reforms, block letters that ripple alive, words that shatter on touch, or letters performing cartoonish actions when clicked.

endless_forward_rush_corridor.name: endless_forward_rush_corridor
endless_forward_rush_corridor.description: An endless corridor or depth-field rush of geometric solids streaking toward the viewer from a vanishing point, steerable and reversible by the pointer or keys. Fits requests for infinite tunnel rushes, flying through receding blocks, or depth-speed corridors controlled by the visitor.

ambient_atmospheric_scene.name: ambient_atmospheric_scene
ambient_atmospheric_scene.description: A calm, atmospheric environmental scene such as rain, water reflections, or fireworks that begins from a quiet holding state or cue and sustains itself endlessly without resolving. Fits requests for ambient rain spectacles, reflective water scenes with drifting light, or unhurried open-sky firework shows that loop forever.

tactile_elastic_plaything.name: tactile_elastic_plaything
tactile_elastic_plaything.description: A single physical-feeling object or surface—such as a thread, ball, glass photo, or solid volume—that stretches, shatters, or deforms under direct click, drag, or pinch, then springs or sweeps back to rest. Fits requests for draggable silky balls, elastic threads snapping back, shatterable glass images, or solid objects you can tear and watch recover.

solitary_rotating_luminous_form.name: solitary_rotating_luminous_form
solitary_rotating_luminous_form.description: A single glowing geometric form or dotted volume floating alone in an empty field, slowly rotating or tumbling on its own while the pointer nudges its spin, hue, or surface. Fits requests for solitary spinning shapes in voids, slow-turning luminous objects, or dotted volumes swirling gently in emptiness.

pointer_reactive_breathing_mass.name: pointer_reactive_breathing_mass
pointer_reactive_breathing_mass.description: A single organic mass, plume, or flower-like bloom that breathes continuously and swells, streams, or leans toward the pointer or camera with visible lag. Fits requests for glowing masses reacting to movement, breathing plumes steering toward the cursor, or luminous blooms tracking the pointer.

parallax_depth_layered_photo.name: parallax_depth_layered_photo
parallax_depth_layered_photo.description: A single photograph or portrait whose apparent depth planes, focus plane, or nested layers shift continuously as the pointer travels across it, producing parallax separation, a sweeping plane of sharpness, or a fanning layered sculpture that eases back to a flat composed image when the pointer stops or leaves. Fits requests for photos that gain depth or parallax under the mouse, hover-driven focus sweeps, lens or blur effects on one picture, and images that separate into apparent depth planes on pointer movement.

liquid_smear_distortion_photo.name: liquid_smear_distortion_photo
liquid_smear_distortion_photo.description: A single photograph or photo panel whose surface deforms like liquid or breaks into hard-edged cells and tiles that drag, smear, zoom, or trail behind the moving pointer with velocity-sensitive reach, then relaxes back to the clean undistorted image once the pointer stops or leaves. Fits requests for cursor-trailing pixel distortion, tile or mosaic smear effects, liquid melt surfaces, cell-zoom photos, and images that deform under fast pointer strokes and self-heal at rest.

trailing_echo_image_copies.name: trailing_echo_image_copies
trailing_echo_image_copies.description: Moving the pointer across a quiet stage emits, drags, or lays down repeated copies of a photograph that appear near the cursor, glide, stretch apart, sink into depth, shrink, or fade as the pointer moves, clearing themselves so the view returns to its resting state when the pointer slows or leaves. Fits requests for pointer echo trails, image stacks that follow the cursor, trailing photo bursts, and ephemeral photo reveals tied to pointer motion.

typographic_list_trailing_image_reveal.name: typographic_list_trailing_image_reveal
typographic_list_trailing_image_reveal.description: A list or editorial index of text entries that shows no pictures until the pointer settles on an entry, at which moment that entry's photograph appears exactly under or behind the pointer and follows it with a trailing lag, optionally warping, smearing, scattering letters, or offsetting colour channels while moving fast, resolving sharp when slowing, and fading away when the pointer leaves the list. Fits requests for typographic name lists or editorial indexes where hovering a line reveals and chases its photo, image reveals tethered to text entries, and pointer-chased pictures over type.

hover_state_patch_and_dual_reveal.name: hover_state_patch_and_dual_reveal
hover_state_patch_and_dual_reveal.description: A single image or portrait panel that reveals an alternate version, transformed state, second picture, or caption overlay through a trailing patch, irregular seeping dissolve, directional sliding panel, or vertical scrub edge controlled by pointer position or dwell, returning to the original state when the pointer leaves. Fits requests for before-and-after image reveals, dual-state portraits with a scrubbing edge, hover-triggered alternate views inside patches, and panels that slide captions in from the pointer direction.

focal_spotlight_awakening_tile_field.name: focal_spotlight_awakening_tile_field
focal_spotlight_awakening_tile_field.description: A grid or field of uniform subdued tiles or thumbnails where attending one locally awakens it through a trailing spotlight pool, a hinged cover swinging open, a bloom of grain, a swelling scale, or a widening focal pool that restores vividness to nearby items while muting the rest, easing back to the identical calm resting look when attention leaves. Fits requests for tile grids with hover spotlights, icon fields that wake individually, thumbnail grids with magnetic focal pools, and hinged tile covers that respond to the pointer.

reactive_ambient_focus_carousel.name: reactive_ambient_focus_carousel
reactive_ambient_focus_carousel.description: A carousel or ring of items where whichever item reaches the focal slot promotes to full clarity and drives a reactive ambient change in the surrounding stage, borrowing its dominant colour, tinting the backdrop, or re-lighting the environment in proportion to the current focus. Fits requests for coverflow rows, depth rings, or centred carousels where the active item colours or tints the background ambience as focus shifts.

inertial_focus_row_with_detail_expand.name: inertial_focus_row_with_detail_expand
inertial_focus_row_with_detail_expand.description: A horizontal row or strip of images moved by weighted drag, flick, or scroll with momentum, damping, and snapping, where the centred item is promoted and may be carried out of its slot into a fullscreen or detail reading view before collapsing back into the exact position it left. Fits requests for browsable image runs or editorial galleries where selecting the focused picture opens it into a full-screen or expanded layout and returns it to place.

momentum_strip_with_motion_deformation.name: momentum_strip_with_motion_deformation
momentum_strip_with_motion_deformation.description: A continuous single-axis run or strip of images dragged or flicked with heavy momentum where speed visibly deforms the items through smearing, stretching, warping, or elastic pull, coasting to a soft stop and snapping to the nearest item. Fits requests for endless photo strips, looping reels, or weighted horizontal runs that stretch, smear, or bend during fast travel.

assembling_spatial_card_arrangement.name: assembling_spatial_card_arrangement
assembling_spatial_card_arrangement.description: Items assemble from scattered positions or a dealt pile into a curving arc or ring that can be drag-spun endlessly, settling with one item centered. Fits requests for card rings, fanning arcs, or gallery arrangements that gather into place from edges or a pile before allowing rotational browsing.

beam_scan_card_procession.name: beam_scan_card_procession
beam_scan_card_procession.description: An endless stream of cards glides laterally through a fixed luminous beam or scanning column that visually transforms the artwork passing through it. Fits requests for card streams or processions that pass through a central decoding light or scanning chamber.

planar_draggable_photo_field.name: planar_draggable_photo_field
planar_draggable_photo_field.description: An edge-to-edge two-dimensional field of photographs drifts freely under pointer drag or wheel input in any direction, sharpening whatever passes through the centre while outer items fade toward neutral. Fits requests for infinite draggable thumbnail planes or spatial photo fields navigated by panning rather than a single linear track.

parallax_scatter_to_fullscreen_takeover.name: parallax_scatter_to_fullscreen_takeover
parallax_scatter_to_fullscreen_takeover.description: A loose field of images or layered cards arranged at mixed depths that glides and tilts opposite the pointer for parallax, where hovering lifts and clarifies the focused item and clicking expands it into a full-screen detail view that clears or suppresses the field until dismissed. Fits requests for depth-layered photo scatters, tilting card fields, or parallax image planes that open into a fullscreen takeover on click.

endless_draggable_image_plane.name: endless_draggable_image_plane
endless_draggable_image_plane.description: An edge-to-edge, boundless plane of photographs or thumbnails that follows a drag or scroll gesture in any direction with trailing momentum, never reaching a boundary, where items may sharpen at the centre or lift into a detail panel when chosen. Fits requests for infinite draggable photo grids, endless panning contact sheets, or edgeless image fields that can be flung around freely.

orbiting_depth_collection.name: orbiting_depth_collection
orbiting_depth_collection.description: Images float at varied depths around a common centre in a quiet surround, drifting gently on their own; dragging swings the entire arrangement around its axis while scrolling or pinching moves the viewpoint nearer or farther, and choosing an item raises it as a large detail view over a suppressed backdrop. Fits requests for orbiting 3D galleries, floating constellations of images, or depth-arranged rings that rotate under drag and support focus selection.

typographic_index_to_media_takeover.name: typographic_index_to_media_takeover
typographic_index_to_media_takeover.description: A calm list or row of large text entries or names where hovering reveals preview imagery behind or beside the lettering, and selecting an entry tears, sweeps, or clears the list away so that the chosen item's media fills the screen in a composed layout until dismissed. Fits requests for name lists that reveal images on hover and transition into full-screen galleries, typographic indexes with trailing previews, or title rows that tear apart into image takeovers.

scattered_teaser_to_composed_arrangement.name: scattered_teaser_to_composed_arrangement
scattered_teaser_to_composed_arrangement.description: Named entries sit among dimmed, loosely scattered teaser images or portraits that shift with pointer movement; choosing an entry gathers the scattered pieces into a brightened, structured composition such as a vertical column or readable gallery while suppressing the rest. Fits requests for scattered preview thumbnails behind collection names that assemble into a neat gallery on selection, or portrait fields that gather into a centered column.

physical_stack_and_heap_browser.name: physical_stack_and_heap_browser
physical_stack_and_heap_browser.description: A pile, fan, or heap of overlapping physical-style cards or prints that spreads open to show all items, pulls a chosen piece forward to rest flat in the centre, steps through the set with shuffling or flipping motions, and always collapses back into the same stack formation. Fits requests for card deck spreads, tossed print heaps, or stacked photo piles that fan out and support stepping through individual cards.

grid_clearaway_focus_transition.name: grid_clearaway_focus_transition
grid_clearaway_focus_transition.description: A uniform grid or wall of evenly spaced, de-emphasised pictures where choosing one triggers a directional sweep, wipe, or outward wave that pushes all other items off-frame, leaving only the selected picture at full strength on a quiet ground, reversible by repeating the motion. Fits requests for photo walls or thumbnail grids that clear away directionally or dissolve outward to isolate a single full-screen image.

atmospheric_depth_header_backdrop.name: atmospheric_depth_header_backdrop
atmospheric_depth_header_backdrop.description: Photos materialise at varied depths around a fixed headline or within a header region, drifting or tilting against one another as the pointer moves, serving as a low-activity atmospheric backdrop rather than a navigable collection. Fits requests for hero headers with scattered parallax background photos, title sections with blooming depth images, or atmospheric image arrivals behind text.

fragmenting_shatter_photo_transition.name: fragmenting_shatter_photo_transition
fragmenting_shatter_photo_transition.description: One full-frame image at a time breaks into geometric pieces—facets, quarters, tiles, shards, or slivers—that scatter, burst, or drift away before the next image coalesces from its own fragments and settles into a still resting state. Fits requests for shattering, fragmenting, exploding, or tile-breaking fullscreen photo transitions where pictures break apart and reassemble.

fluid_dissolve_photo_transition.name: fluid_dissolve_photo_transition
fluid_dissolve_photo_transition.description: One full-frame image at a time transitions to the next through liquid-like warping, melting, droplet dissolution, or flowing ripple sweeps, settling back into a gentle continuous motion or still rest once the swap completes. Fits requests for melting, dissolving, liquid, watery, or fluid-flow fullscreen photo transitions between images.

page_leaf_turn_gallery.name: page_leaf_turn_gallery
page_leaf_turn_gallery.description: Images or content panels are presented as leaves of a bound volume, album, or disc that turn with depth shading, folding around an edge or flipping over an axis to reveal the next page beneath. Fits requests for page-turn, leaf-turn, book-flip, or bound-album image viewers and chaptered photo volumes.

kinetic_captioned_stage_swap.name: kinetic_captioned_stage_swap
kinetic_captioned_stage_swap.description: One captioned image owns a quiet stage and is exchanged for the next via dramatic kinetic motion—flinging, springing, elastic stretching, bursting titles, rolling off, or sweeping retreats—with the accompanying text performing its own matching entrance and exit. Fits requests for energetic, bouncy, elastic, or dramatically animated fullscreen captioned photo swaps where text and image move together.

granular_particle_photo_assembly.name: granular_particle_photo_assembly
granular_particle_photo_assembly.description: A photograph materializes from a dispersed swarm of tiny self-lit specks or grains that sweep in, settle, and gently drift while readable, then loosen and scatter as the next image gathers from particles. Fits requests for particle, grain, speck, or dust-assembly fullscreen photo showcases where images form from scattered dots.

curtain_wipe_photo_transition.name: curtain_wipe_photo_transition
curtain_wipe_photo_transition.description: One full-frame image at a time is replaced by opaque bands sweeping across, hand-brushed erasure strokes, or tearing distortions that hide the current picture and unveil the next underneath. Fits requests for curtain-sweep, band-wipe, brush-erase, or tear-away fullscreen photo transitions.

tiled_batch_grid_swap.name: tiled_batch_grid_swap
tiled_batch_grid_swap.description: A screen-filling grid of same-sized image tiles advances in batches: every tile's contents slide out or are covered by sweeping shapes at staggered moments, rippling across the whole arrangement to reveal the next batch in the same frames. Fits requests for grid-based, tiled, or batch-swapping image showcases where multiple tiles change together in sequence.

inertial_distortion_scroll_column.name: inertial_distortion_scroll_column
inertial_distortion_scroll_column.description: Images in a vertical column or wall deform, shear, tilt, stretch, or smear as a direct function of scroll velocity and momentum, snapping back to their rest shape when motion stops. Fits requests for elastic, inertial, speed-reactive, skewing, or momentum-bent photo columns where movement itself visibly distorts the pictures and typography.

resolution_progression_scroll_reveal.name: resolution_progression_scroll_reveal
resolution_progression_scroll_reveal.description: Each image in a downward sequence begins obscured by blur, desaturation, coarse blocking, or an edge wipe and progressively resolves into full sharpness, colour, or clarity strictly as a function of how far it has travelled through the view. Fits requests for images that sharpen, clear, de-pixelate, or desaturate-to-colour on scroll, and focus-isolated galleries where only the centre reads crisp.

aperture_chapter_scroll_scrub.name: aperture_chapter_scroll_scrub
aperture_chapter_scroll_scrub.description: Full-viewport sections or chapters open outward from a small central aperture or pinned stage as scroll advances, revealing composed arrangements of stills, clips, and titles that hold their positions while pinned and reverse exactly when pushed back. Fits requests for scroll-scrubbed chapter reveals, expanding aperture frames, pinned theme sections, and staged image groups that assemble under scroll control.

momentum_cinematic_photo_descent.name: momentum_cinematic_photo_descent
momentum_cinematic_photo_descent.description: A smooth, eased-momentum descent through large single photographs where each image dominates the view, stretches or dissolves as it exits, and is accompanied by titles, numbers, or captions that travel in proportion to overall progress. Fits requests for cinematic scroll-through photo essays, momentum-smoothed editorial descents, and portfolio galleries that step into reading views.

tilting_artwork_procession.name: tilting_artwork_procession
tilting_artwork_procession.description: Photographs or artworks travel up through a quiet stage, tipping in edge-on, rotating fully square near mid-view, then tilting away and dimming as they leave, with oversized names or titles drifting alongside in proportion to scroll distance. Fits requests for meandering tilting photo columns, artwork processions with travelling name bands, and mirrored-ceiling gallery runs.

pinned_caption_crossfade_stage.name: pinned_caption_crossfade_stage
pinned_caption_crossfade_stage.description: A framed or full-bleed picture stage locks mid-screen while scrolling cross-fades between images, surfacing rising captions, giant names, or short text blocks one at a time in sync with the picture changes. Fits requests for pinned portrait runs with oversized typography, locked stages with rising captions, and stationary cross-fade galleries driven by scroll.

fragment_parallax_poster.name: fragment_parallax_poster
fragment_parallax_poster.description: Tall poster compositions built from torn fragments, slivers, or layered pieces of a single image that drift apart at different parallax rates and directions under scroll, separating into depth layers and reassembling on reverse. Fits requests for fragmented parallax posters, scattered sliver sequences, and torn-photo layering effects.

lateral_panorama_scroll_tour.name: lateral_panorama_scroll_tour
lateral_panorama_scroll_tour.description: A wide panoramic photograph or guided tour lives inside a fixed frame or band, panning laterally across the scene as the visitor scrolls vertically, steering zoom and tilt between resting stops without changing scroll direction. Fits requests for horizontal panorama bands, scroll-steered photo tours, and lateral camera pans driven by vertical scroll.

in_place_character_scramble_resolve.name: in_place_character_scramble_resolve
in_place_character_scramble_resolve.description: A single held focal slot of type is restated in place: its characters churn through wrong forms and settle into the intended wording, driven by an advance, a toggle, a hover or a scroll nudge, and the slot is always left readable and can be replayed or reversed. Fits requests for scramble, decode and glitch-resolve headlines, letter-by-letter text swaps, self-decoding screens with replay controls, and any quiet screen whose subject is one line of text changing its wording where it stands.

centered_line_procession_and_completion.name: centered_line_procession_and_completion
centered_line_procession_and_completion.description: Lines of text travel vertically through a fixed high-contrast center of attention while neighbouring lines sit paler and unresolved, driven purely by scrolling or automatic procession so that only the centered phrase is solid and fully legible at any moment. Fits requests for line-by-line steppers, cryptic line processions, phrase columns that complete a fixed lead line, creased-sheet scrollers, and any vertical list where focus is determined by proximity to a stationary reading band.

stroke_drawn_lettering_replay.name: stroke_drawn_lettering_replay
stroke_drawn_lettering_replay.description: Words already sit finished in their stacked layers; pressing a control makes them slip away and rebuild letter by letter with strokes drawing in from one end, landing back in the finished state, with a small replay control that disappears while the word draws. Fits requests for self-drawing typography, stroke-written word specimens, and replayable handwriting reveals on flat panels.

liquid_label_morph_swap.name: liquid_label_morph_swap
liquid_label_morph_swap.description: A sparse list of oversized labels where the attended entry swells, smears into thick fused rounded shapes, melts down, and re-sharpens as its paired short detail before flowing back to the label when attention leaves, while other labels stay quiet and readable. Fits requests for melting or morphing label-to-detail swaps and liquid text transitions triggered by pointer focus.

gathering_centre_assembly_reveal.name: gathering_centre_assembly_reveal
gathering_centre_assembly_reveal.description: Items sweep up from outside the view, gather into one dense cluster at the centre beneath a focal title, then open outward into an evenly spaced layout while the central title resolves from soft haze into crisp lettering and everything settles into a calm resting state. Fits requests for pile assembly intros, gathering ring reveals around a focal title, and spatial converge-then-spread introductions.

fullscreen_audio_reactive_canvas.name: fullscreen_audio_reactive_canvas
fullscreen_audio_reactive_canvas.description: A fullscreen visual field driven directly by playing audio, typically mapping separate frequency bands to distinct large-scale and fine-detail layers so the sound-to-image link reads within seconds. The scene owns the entire viewport with no chrome or progress, keeps re-forming indefinitely as the audio runs, and is entered through a quiet start cue that clears exactly as the sound begins. Fits requests for music visualizers, beat-driven abstract spectacles, and click-to-start fullscreen sound pieces whose imagery pulses, swells, glitches, or drifts in continuous step with the track.

sparse_depth_stage_audio_centerpiece.name: sparse_depth_stage_audio_centerpiece
sparse_depth_stage_audio_centerpiece.description: A low-distraction stage or depth field where one central self-luminous form or sparse cluster floats against a near-empty surround, pulsing and breathing with the playing audio while the surrounding space remains calm. The visitor can orbit, zoom, drag, or swing around the centerpiece without breaking the sound-driven motion. Fits requests for minimal sound-reactive centerpieces, console-style audio displays with readouts, instrumented glowing orbs, and quiet depth scenes where a single floating body carries the audio response.

painted_emission_trail_field.name: painted_emission_trail_field
painted_emission_trail_field.description: An empty or uniform field where the pointer acts as an emitter, painting trails of fire, smoke, bubbles, frost, or particles exactly along its stroke that rise, drift, cool, or dissolve and then vanish entirely, leaving the canvas clean for the next pass. Fits requests for cursor-drawn fire, smoke trails, particle ribbons, rising bubble wands, heat brushes, and ephemeral drawing toys where the medium fades away rather than accumulating.

heavy_liquid_body_playground.name: heavy_liquid_body_playground
heavy_liquid_body_playground.description: A pool, tank, basin, or floating mass of continuous liquid or jelly substance at rest that shoves, splashes, stretches, sloshes, or ripples under direct pointer contact and always drains, rebounds, or settles back to a calm surface or shape. Fits requests for water simulations, liquid tanks, ripple ponds, gravity pools, fluid sculptures, squishy jelly blobs, and full-screen goo playgrounds.

springy_discrete_element_field.name: springy_discrete_element_field
springy_discrete_element_field.description: A grid, floor, or open space densely populated by discrete blocks, tiles, shapes, or small objects that deform locally under the pointer—dipping, flipping, swelling, or scattering—and spring, ripple, or drift back to their resting arrangement after the pointer passes. Fits requests for interactive tile floors, springy block grids, tumbling object piles, press-ripple surfaces, and cursor-wake arrays of individual elements.

hanging_tethered_pendulum.name: hanging_tethered_pendulum
hanging_tethered_pendulum.description: A single sheet of cloth or an object hanging from a fixed point or edge that sways, drags, stretches, tears, or swings when pushed or pulled by the pointer, always governed by gravity and tension returning it toward a downward rest state. Fits requests for hanging cloth, pinned fabric you can tear, swinging lamps, tethered pendulums, and dangling cards on a string.

self_organizing_pattern_field.name: self_organizing_pattern_field
self_organizing_pattern_field.description: An edge-to-edge field of chemical-like patterns or vein networks that continuously mutates, knots, or branches on its own, and whose growth routes, density, or structure are steered by pointer-painted nutrients or seeds. Fits requests for reaction-diffusion canvases, living pattern fields, self-organizing veins, and generative nutrient-painting simulations.

particle_swarm_shape_morphing.name: particle_swarm_shape_morphing
particle_swarm_shape_morphing.description: A cloud or swarm of many tiny, clearly separated points or specks that continuously sweeps together to form a crisp shape, shimmers and drifts while holding it, then streams apart on control activation to resettle into the next figure in an unbroken endless flow. Fits requests for dot particle swarms that morph between shapes, breathing point clouds forming figures, and glowing speck constellations that cycle forms endlessly.

soft_mass_drifting_ambient.name: soft_mass_drifting_ambient
soft_mass_drifting_ambient.description: One soft-edged mass, blob, cloud or wash on a plain, evenly toned ground slowly stretches, swells, thins, reshapes and drifts in an endless loop with no goal, sometimes retuned by compact controls without restarting or resolving the motion. Fits requests for calm ambient liquid blobs, drifting morphing clouds, slow organic washes, and meditative soft-body visuals watched for their own sake.

geometric_breathing_symmetry.name: geometric_breathing_symmetry
geometric_breathing_symmetry.description: A single symmetric geometric form such as nested rings, a spindle or a fractal bloom that breathes, swells or unfolds in slow repeating pulses or mirrored waves, often centred and radially organized, looping forever without input. Fits requests for breathing geometric shapes, pulsing concentric rings, symmetrical fractal blooms, and rhythmic expanding abstract patterns.

vertical_shaft_endless_descent.name: vertical_shaft_endless_descent
vertical_shaft_endless_descent.description: A view directed down or through a bottomless vertical shaft whose walls or panels are clearly structured, with blocks or objects descending or ricocheting endlessly through depth while the structure or camera turns slowly. Fits requests for infinite falling shafts, endless descending block tunnels, bottomless pit drops, and perpetual vertical descent loops.

tilted_wave_surface_field.name: tilted_wave_surface_field
tilted_wave_surface_field.description: A tilted, receding surface made of many small blocks or specks stretching into the distance, traversed by slow overlapping waves, swells or pulses that radiate or roll endlessly across the field, sometimes adjustable via live controls. Fits requests for breathing wave grids, tilting particle surfaces with ripples, luminous block wave fields, and perspective grid undulations.

reflective_water_ambient_scene.name: reflective_water_ambient_scene
reflective_water_ambient_scene.description: An atmospheric scene built around a broad reflective water surface, where glints, shimmering light tracks from a luminous source, or fine grain stir endlessly beneath a slowly traveling vantage that can be steered. Fits requests for calm water reflections, shimmering lake ambient scenes, luminous discs over water, and slow drifting water vistas.

typographic_ambient_motion.name: typographic_ambient_motion
typographic_ambient_motion.description: Letters or short words presented as thick glyphs, wrapped volumes or revolving drums that tip, ripple, breathe or turn endlessly in a quiet near-empty field, maintaining readable typography as the primary visual element in continuous motion. Fits requests for moving text screensavers, breathing typography, revolving letter cylinders, rippling word displays, and glass-wrapped type animations.

drifting_depth_creature_field.name: drifting_depth_creature_field
drifting_depth_creature_field.description: A deep or fogged spatial field populated by many small translucent or hazy creature-like bodies at varying distances, drifting endlessly out of view and refilling while a self-swaying or pointer-steered vantage moves slowly through the volume. Fits requests for ambient jellyfish fields, submerged drifting creature scenes, hazy depth organisms, and endless underwater entity drifts.
